Pestilence prevents buildings from firing projectiles and
slows unit production.

1104.Name: pillar of tlalocan
1104.Description:
Target a location to call down the Pillar of Tlalocan,
obliterating fortifications on impact. The statue remains to
defend the area with water strikes until destroyed.

1105.Name: plague of serpents
1105.Description:
Target a location on the map where dangerous Serpents will
rise from the ground or sea and protect that area from your
enemies.

1108.Name: prosperous seeds
1108.Description:
Target 2 Farms to sow the seeds of prosperity. They will
produce food faster, heal nearby villagers, and make
friendly units on them invisible.

1109.Name: purge
1109.Description:
Target an enemy military unit to mark it for sacrifice. The
unit is suspended in the air, and after a short delay, all
nearby enemies of the same type are destroyed, up to a
total of 1500 resource value.

1110.Name: ragnarok
1110.Description:
Target anywhere on the map to permanently transform all
of your Gatherers and Dwarves into mighty Heroes of
Ragnarok.

1113.Name: sacred gate
1113.Description:
Target a location to erect a great Torii Gate which makes
your God Powers cheaper and immediately enables you to
invoke them once again for free.

1114.Name: shifting sands
1114.Description:
Target your own or allied units, and then target the location
where you wish to teleport them.

1115.Name: shockwave
1115.Description:
Target a location on the map to send enemy units flying,
stunning them for a few seconds.

1117.Name: shrine of the hunt
1117.Description:
Target a Shrine to transform it into a Shrine of the Hunt,
periodically spawning huntable deer as well as friendly
wolves that defend the area.

1119.Name: solar shield
1119.Description: Target a unit to make it temporarily nearly invulnerable.

1121.Name: spider lair
1121.Description:
Target an area to place spider eggs which will hatch and
burrow. The spiders will devour enemy human soldiers that
cross through the area, but eggs can be destroyed before
they hatch.

1122.Name: spy
1122.Description: ee Target an enemy unit to secretly see what it sees.

1124.Name: swampland
1124.Description:
Target a location to create a temporary swamp infested with
Kappa that will leap out of the water and drown enemy
human soldiers.

1126.Name: tartarian gate
1126.Description:
Hekate opens a gate to the Underworld that unleashes
creatures hostile to all. The gate will destroy any buildings
in the vicinity when it is placed.

1127.Name: tempest
1127.Description:
materialize into a spectral Hill Fort when fully constructed.
Builds faster in later ages.

1128.Name: the peach blossom spring
1128.Description:
Target a location to create the Peach Blossom Spring, whose
resource stockpile grows over time. The Peach Blossom
Spring's resources are gathered very quickly, but its
stockpile stops growing once a villager starts gathering
from it.

1129.Name: thunder burst
1129.Description:
Target a location to unleash earth-shaking shockwaves.
Raijin strikes his den-den daiko drums, causing expanding
rings of lightning to damage and stun enemies.

1132.Name: undermine
1132.Description:
1] Target a path of destruction along which to damage enemy
buildings. Walls and towers instantly collapse, and other
buildings take considerable damage.

1133.Name: underworld invasion
1133.Description:

Settlements cannot be repopulated for some time.

1135.Name: valor
1135.Description:
Target one of your human units to convert it into a hero
and heal it fully.

1138.Name: volcano
1138.Description:
Target a location to raise a mighty Volcano. It obliterates
buildings as it rises, and bombards the surrounding area
with molten rock.

1140.Name: wither
1140.Description:
Target a location to wither berries, farms, and trees,
rendering the terrain sterile for a short period of time.
